headers.//: Every HTML response, including '/' and every SPA route, which all rewrite to index.html. Must come before the asset rules below; see the note in the commit.
Crawler files change when the public route list changes, which is a deploy, so they follow the shell rather than being cached for a year.
Safe to mark immutable only because the production build sets outputHashing: all, so a changed file always has a changed name.
Long, but not immutable: these filenames are not content-hashed, so a re-shot screenshot keeps its name and must be able to win eventually.
Firebase sets none of these by default. HSTS is deliberately absent because the host already sends it, with preload.

ENFORCING as of 2026-09-21: deployed Report-Only first and confirmed no violations in the console. The sha256 is the inline theme script in index.html, which prevents a flash of the wrong theme and must keep working; recompute it if that script ever changes. style-src needs unsafe-inline because Angular injects component styles into the document at runtime and the build inlines critical CSS: there is no nonce to attach to those, so this is a genuine limitation rather than laziness. The two Cloudflare hosts are different on purpose: pub-*.r2.dev serves uploaded images back, and *.r2.cloudflarestorage.com is where the browser PUTs a new upload through a presigned URL.
